definition: RP counts distinct printed pages in explicitly documented references, bibliography, source notes, and endnote sections. It excludes indexes, acknowledgments, glossaries, inline citations and online supplements. Catalog-only ranges can omit separately unlisted notes; section scope is retained.
confidence: Moderate for catalogued ranges and contents boundaries; unknown for missing counts.
scoring: RP is optional, disabled and weighted zero by default. Existing scores and gates are unchanged.
